{{Quote|We will not fight them at all. We would rather die than to kill others.|Tee Watt Kaa|<ref name="DoP">{{TCW|Defenders of Peace}}</ref>}}
'''Tee Watt Kaa''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Lurmen]] who led a [[Lurmen village|village]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories|Outer Rim]] [[Planet|world]] of [[Maridun]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. A devout pacifist, Kaa refused to engage in any sort of combat, even if his own [[Death|life]] was in danger.

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars]],<ref name="DB:TWK" /> Tee Watt Kaa lead his pacifist<ref name="VE">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> colony of [[Lurmen]] in a [[Lurmen village|village]] on [[Maridun]]. Alongside his son [[Wag Too]],<ref name="DB:TWK" /> he sought to find peace and solace away from the war,<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> preferring to remain neutral and avoid [[The galaxy|galactic]] politics and conflict.<ref name="VE" />

Following the [[Battle of Quell|Battle]] at [[Quell]], Kaa then met [[Jedi Master]] [[Aayla Secura]], [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], and Clone Commander [[Bly]]. At first, he did not welcome the [[Jedi]], saying that they were not peacekeepers. He told them leave in order to preserve their peace. However, he could not ignore Ahsoka's plea for help for [[Anakin Skywalker|her badly wounded master]]. He allowed his healer son, Wag Too, to go with her and Bly while Secura stayed behind at his village. Kaa then gave Secura a drink to help her. During their time together, Secura and Kaa spoke about the Jedi's intentions to restore peace by fighting for the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]].<ref name="Jedi Crash" />

Kaa and his fellow villagers then saw a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] [[C-9979 landing craft|landing ship]] coming towards their village. At first, he thought the Separatists were coming for the Jedi, but Tano told him that they did not know they were here. Kaa then told the Jedi to leave before they were found. He, despite Tano's objections, then went to speak with the Separatists. Kaa then met the Separatist commanding officer, [[General]] [[Lok Durd]]. Kaa stood by as Durd's [[battle droid]]s searched the village for weapons and Republic contraband. Durd then told Kaa that he would do more random searches to ensure security on the planet. After the Separatists left, Kaa then spoke with his son about preserving their peace.<ref name="DoP" />

The Jedi soon learned of Durd's plan to test a new weapon, the [[Defoliator]], on the Lurmen village. The weapon had the ability to destroy any organic life but leave battle droids unharmed. Kaa was informed of this by the Jedi, who wanted to help [[Defense of Maridun|defend the village]]. Kaa refused their help, however, due to his firm belief against fighting and conflict. His son, Wag Too, and his friends believed they should help the Jedi and clones defend the village. While the Republic group set up shield generators, which they had stolen from the Separatist base, around the village, they attempted to fight off the droids and protect the Lurmen. Wag Too and his friends eventually helped fight back, but Kaa was still curious about what the true cost of them fighting back was.<ref name="DoP" />

==Personality and traits==
Tee Watt Kaa was Lurmen [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> who was 1.03 [[meter]]s, or 3 [[Foot|feet]], 5 inches tall,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> white [[Color|white]] [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> Kaa made his beard stiff with apis wax. He was the founder and leader of the Lurmen colony on Maridun. He was a passionate believer in the peaceful way of thinking known as [[Te Padka]]. Kaa refused to fight, even in defense, believing that war corrupts and destroys everything it touches. Kaa's beliefs were tested when General Lok Durd brought his Separatist army to his doorstep, forcing the peaceful colonists to make a painful choice.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Skills and abilities==
Kaa was the leader of the Lurmen colony on Maridun. He was also skilled in persuasion and debates.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tee Watt Kaa first appeared in the thirteenth episode of [[The Clone Wars: Season One|season one]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', "[[Jedi Crash]]," and was voiced by [[George Coe]].
